scientific_question: Can a small FP16 low-rank correction, selected in a polar-sensitive basis, repair the Muon direction lost by a packed E5M8 or E5M6 ambient-momentum state while retaining a meaningful training-state reduction?

uniform_minifloat_rejection.finding: Uniform E5M8 is almost exact in ordinary pre-polar cosine but misses after Muon's nonlinear polar map. Another uniform precision or block-size sweep is forbidden.

theory.polar_differential: For H=U Sigma V^T, in-frame polar perturbations contain factors 1/(sigma_i+sigma_j), while orthogonal-complement perturbations contain sigma_i^{-1}. Quantization error in weak singular directions can therefore dominate post-polar error even when Frobenius reconstruction is nearly exact.
theory.representation: Persist a tightly packed E5M-b base state plus a rank-r FP16 correction A B^T. Materialize the corrected state only transiently for the ordinary production Muon update.
theory.capacity_objective: At a frozen optimizer request, compare a residual-SVD basis with a basis selected by the exact gradient of post-polar directional error. In each fixed basis, fit only a small r by r core against the exact Newton-Schulz output, then absorb that core into A for persistent byte accounting.
theory.why_capacity_first: A fixed-state passing result establishes only that the required direction lies in a compact structured correction. It does not establish a causal rule for updating A and B through time. A language-model endpoint before that causal rule would confound representation capacity with optimizer dynamics.
non_claims: This oracle does not update model parameters through any candidate path.
It does not claim that per-step core fitting is a production optimizer.
It does not authorize a loss endpoint, scale-up, horizon transfer, learning-rate sweep, or attention change.

frozen_representation.forward_weight: Keep the successful Pair-VQ base, forward-visible fractional-lattice feedback, and c_proj fast residual bit-identical.
frozen_representation.attention: Keep QK-only BlockFHT attention and dense V/c_proj exactly as in the successful parent.
frozen_representation.owner: The production optimizer remains the exact FP16 ambient-momentum Pair-VQ Muon owner. All candidates are detached nonintervening sidecars.
frozen_representation.optimizer_request: For reference momentum B and current gradient G, form H_ref=G+mu*B. For a candidate B_hat, form H_hat=G+mu*B_hat and apply the same five-step Newton-Schulz Muon map.
forbidden_changes: Pair-VQ codebooks, codes, feedback codec, gains, levels, or refresh schedule
attention target scope, model width, data order, seeds, optimizer, learning rate, or schedule
hidden dense momentum, FP32 residual, candidate parameter update, or candidate checkpoint
candidate-specific rank, optimizer iterations, thresholds, or post-hoc basis choice

frozen_protocol.owner_replay: Replay the exact nine-update registered parent seed/data/config from scratch. At each probe, advance the FP16 reference recurrence and score candidates against the same detached gradient before the owner step.

base_formats.encoding: Use the already tested deterministic FP16-exponent round-to-nearest-even implementation. No scale, dense residual, stochastic rounding, or error feedback is allowed.

basis_families.residual_svd: Compute a deterministic randomized rank-32 SVD of R=B_ref-Q(B_ref); use its leading U_r and V_r.
basis_families.polar_gradient: At zero correction, differentiate one minus cosine between the exact reference Muon update and candidate Muon update with respect to the candidate momentum state. Compute a deterministic randomized rank-32 SVD of the negative gradient and use its leading U_r and V_r.

randomized_svd.rng_isolation: Use torch.random.fork_rng so the owner training/data RNG streams are unchanged.

core_fit.form: B_hat=Q(B_ref)+U_r K V_r^T; after fitting, store A=U_r K and B=V_r so no separate persistent core is counted.
core_fit.optimizer: deterministic torch LBFGS with strong-Wolfe line search
core_fit.objective: relative squared error of the exact production Muon update plus 0.01 times relative squared momentum-state reconstruction error

controls.rank_zero: The corresponding E5M base without a correction.
controls.full_residual: B_hat=B_ref; must reproduce every reference direction metric to at least 0.99999999.
controls.objective_monotonicity: For a fitted candidate, final objective must not exceed its initialized objective by more than 1e-10.

measurements: momentum-state, combined pre-polar, and post-polar relative error, cosine, positive-line recovery, and every-matrix minima
per-matrix singular spectrum of the uncorrected post-polar error and cumulative rank-4/8/16/32 energy fractions
initialized and fitted objective, LBFGS closure count, fit wall time, and maximum allocated memory
packed base bytes, FP16 factor bytes, total persistent MLP training bytes, dense-state reduction factor, and transient expansion FLOPs

staging_and_futility.stage_a: Evaluate E5M8 for both basis families and all registered ranks. If no E5M8 candidate passes a probe, do not evaluate E5M6 at that probe.
staging_and_futility.stage_b: Evaluate E5M6 at a probe only when at least one E5M8 candidate passes every direction threshold at that same probe.
staging_and_futility.family_early_rejection: If the FP16/full-residual control passes and no E5M8 rank at most 32 passes update 0, reject the useful-rank low-rank correction family without update 8.
staging_and_futility.final_selection: Among candidates that pass both registered probes, choose minimum total persistent bytes; break ties by higher minimum every-matrix post-polar cosine.

decision_gate.if_pass: Authorize only derivation of a causal factor recurrence, exact encode/decode/checkpoint tests, and a production-path >=20% MFU preflight. Do not authorize a language-model loss endpoint.
decision_gate.if_fail: Reject useful-rank additive low-rank history correction. Retain FP16 ambient momentum as the working training-state floor and return to a factored polar-history representation rather than another coordinate quantizer.

execution_policy.implementation_before_execution: Add focused mathematical/unit tests, exact source/config/plan hashing, detached RNG tests, and scratch-result redirection before any remote scientific run.
execution_policy.performance_gate: Run the exact nine-update observer config through the project MFU preflight, charging both registered probe computations to elapsed time. Require aggregate MFU >=0.20 and at least eight timed owner updates before launch.
execution_policy.monitoring: The MFU test is foreground-polled. If the gated scientific oracle is expected or observed to exceed five minutes, attach one persistent terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog; do not emit intermediate progress milestones for an intended one-to-two-hour diagnostic.
execution_policy.gpu_and_driver: Use PRO6 GPU0 only when exclusive and pin the matching 595.71.05 compatibility library path.
